flows.title: Express Trust Creation Flow
flows.description: Flow from identifying a potential express trust through three certainties, formalities, constitution, sham/illusory check, to outcome determination.

flows.title: Resulting Trust Analysis Flow
flows.description: Flow from identifying a voluntary transfer or purchase-money contribution through presumptions, rebuttal, Quistclose check, to outcome determination.

flows.title: Constructive Trust Assessment Flow
flows.description: Flow from identifying the type of constructive trust claim (CICT, bribe, or accessory) through element analysis to quantification and remedy.

flows.title: Equitable Tracing Flow
flows.description: Flow from identifying traceable trust property through fiduciary relationship, substitute/mixed fund analysis, to proprietary claim determination.
